name: Open sea
description: Open sea far from the shore: a shallow seabed of mud and stones, a few bare rock skerries where seals haul out and gulls rest, and the sea's own fish and birds.
about: Biome for every open-ocean cell (game proposal 0047): no trees, ground plants, lakes, bogs or streams. One biome serves every sea: the tile gives its land style (`land`, the nearest coast's), its name (the sea's, from seas/names.json), its animals and its land share, which sets how many skerries rise. The land style below is only the default.
author: Animundo team
